name: EPIC 211491196
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 23.2 solar radii and 1.07 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211491196 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 23.175843 (16th-84th percentiles 21.348091-25.338857), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 11,206 parsecs away, 23 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.07 solar masses and 23.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,431 K at its surface.
